integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained for the stated stretched-exponential family. Related occupancy literature is credited. No independent audit or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns Poissonized counts only and makes no de-Poissonization claim. The beta=1 limit depends on the fractional logarithmic phase; the beta>1 non-Gaussian obstruction is proved along tuned subsequences. It does not classify all regular-variation-index-zero frequency sequences.
title: A sharp Gaussian-fluctuation threshold for stretched-exponential urn frequencies
